effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When effects suspend any of your [WG] trait Digimon, this Digimon may digivolve into a [WG] trait Digimon card in the hand without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your Digimon with the [WG] trait may unsuspend.
